questions.question: What is a fuel?

answers.b: A substance that you burn to get heat (energy)
answers.c: A substance that puts out a fire

questions.question: Name the three things needed to make something burn (fire triangle)

answers.d: Fuel, oxygen and a temperature above the ignition temperature

questions.question: What is the ignition temperature?

answers.b: The temperature at which a substance starts to burn
answers.c: The temperature at which a substance boils
answers.d: The temperature at which a substance melts

questions.question: Why does a fire blanket put out a fire?

answers.c: The oxygen can no longer reach the fuel

questions.question: Why does water cool a fire?

answers.a: The temperature falls below the ignition temperature
answers.b: Water removes the oxygen from the fuel
answers.c: Water wets the fuel so that it dissolves
answers.d: Water is not a fuel itself
